title: On a channel row, task.deleted_summary does not count
why: The noise subtypes never count, on any row kind, as RisingWave counts them. Decided (Tenny, #14988 review): follow the server (RisingWave). The canonical Postgres inline read in getInboxItems still counts them.

knownGaps.reason: web's live patch (liveUnreadFields) applies the noise subtypes on thread rows only, so it counts this on a channel or DM row
knownGaps.followUp: step 2 switches web to the shared predicate
